title: Work through setup at your own pace

handbook.what: The first-run wizard that takes a brand-new school from nothing to teachers, courses and classes. It is four short steps and it does not have to be done in one sitting.
handbook.where: Settings, then First-time setup. The steps are listed down the left, and **Save & exit** sits at the bottom of every one.
how: Open the wizard and work down the steps on the left — your school, your staff, your courses, your classes.
**Continue** saves the step you are on and moves you to the next one.
Tap any step in the left-hand list to jump straight to it, forwards or back.
**Save & exit** puts you back on your dashboard with everything you have entered kept.
Come back to Settings and First-time setup whenever you want to carry on.
handbook.note: Nothing here is a one-shot. Everything the wizard sets up — the school name, the invite links, the classes — can also be changed later from Settings and from your class pages.
